{{Quote|I'm sorry, I can't rescue your brother from the narkaa. I left my hero suit in the cabin.|Han Solo, joking about his children encountering the aquatic predators|<ref name="Shield of Lies" />}}
'''Narkaa''' were an aquatic predatory creature [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]]. Narkaa also had razor-sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]],<ref name="CWSE" /> and the fish lived in schools together.<ref name="Shield of Lies" /> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="VacayDate">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' dated the events of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] vacation to twelve years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dated [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore the vacation occurred during [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] told his children about the narkaa surrounding the sunken [[Freighter/Legends|freigher]] ''[[Just Cause]]'' on a [[Solo family/Legends|family]] vacation to [[Illafian Point]]'s beaches.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Narkaa were mentioned in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="Shield of Lies" /> The creatures were cut from the [[Shield of Lies (abridged audiobook)|abridged audiobook]] release.<ref name="Abridged">''[[Shield of Lies (abridged audiobook)]]''</ref>
